description: This file defines an abstract base class for unit tests related to activation repartitioning in Orleans. It provides setup and teardown methods, as well as utility functions to initialize and adjust activation counts across silos in a test environment.

classes.name: RepartitioningTestBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for Orleans activation repartitioning tests, providing setup, teardown, and activation count adjustment utilities for subclasses.

methods.name: RepartitioningTestBase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test fixture and sets up silo addresses and repartitioner system targets.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including forcing activation collection and resetting counters.

methods.name: ResetCounters
methods.description: Resets counters on all silos' repartitioner system targets.

methods.name: AdjustActivationCountOffsets
methods.description: Adjusts activation counts across silos to account for imbalances, making counts balanced for testing.
